reviews.text:
this is SO different from any western mascaras i have used! it naturally curls and holds my straight asian lashes, has a light-weight non clumping feel, has survived 3 crying sessions AND a shower all in one day. 

the only complaint i have is that the black #10 Sharp Curl has a slight ashy-gray tint to it when viewed from the side. not sure if i’s being too nit-picky but that has been bothering me :/ other then that, this is a great mascara!
reviews.zh:
同我用過嘅任何西方品牌睫毛液完全唔同！佢自然捲曲兼 hold 住我直嘅亞洲睫毛，感覺輕身唔結塊，仲撐過咗一日入面 3 次喊同沖涼。

我唯一嘅投訴係黑色 #10 Sharp Curl 從側面睇有少少灰調。唔知係咪我太挑剔，但呢點真係困擾住我 :/ 除此之外，呢支係一支好好嘅睫毛液！

reviews.text: easily one of my most favorite mascaras! i’ve never found a mascara that didn’t smudge since i have oily skin, especially around my eyes. the mascara looks decent on it’s own, but i like to use it with a primer to also help with volume! i love the brush, it’s small and fits around smaller eyes very nicely. my eyelashes look so fluttery when i use this with an eyelash curler. it doesn’t add much curl by itself, but will hold a curl from an eyelash curler. i will definitely repurchase!
reviews.zh: 輕鬆成為我最鍾意嘅睫毛液之一！我油性肌，特別係眼周，一直以嚟都搵唔到一支唔會暈染嘅睫毛液。單用呢支已經唔錯，但我鍾意配打底霜一齊用，幫助增量！我好鍾意支刷，細細支好啱細眼仔。用睫毛夾配合，睫毛睇落好飄逸。單用佢唔會增加好多捲度，但可以保持住睫毛夾嘅捲度。一定會回購！

reviews.text: One of the best mascaras I’ve used so far, especially on stubborn Asian lashes. I used to use Kiss me Heroine mascara all the time as it was the only mascara that could hold the curl, but it had one downside: it always smudged on my lower eyelid. I’ve been testing this mascara for the past 2 days and not only it holds the curl all day but also doesn’t smudge at all! That being said if you’re looking for volume Long Curling might not give you those full lashes. It does its job lengthening the lashes pretty well though. The brush is very much Asian lash-friendly!
reviews.zh: 我用過最好嘅睫毛液之一，尤其係對付難搞嘅亞洲睫毛。我以前成日用 Kiss me Heroine 睫毛液，因為係唯一支 hold 到捲度嘅睫毛液，但有一個缺點：永遠都會喺下眼瞼暈染。過去兩日我試緊呢支，佢唔單止成日 hold 到捲度，仲完全唔暈染！話雖如此，如果你想要豐盈效果，Long Curling 未必畀到你嗰種濃密睫毛。不過佢喺增長方面表現幾好。支刷好啱亞洲睫毛！

reviews.text:
I am absolutely thrilled with this mascara! It has completely transformed my lashes, giving them length, volume, and definition that I never thought possible. The formula is not only long-lasting but also smudge-proof, keeping my lashes looking fabulous all day long.

What sets this mascara apart is its innovative brush design. The bristles are perfectly spaced, ensuring that every lash is coated with just the right amount of product. The wand is easy to maneuver, allowing for precise application without clumps or mess. It effortlessly lifts and separates each lash, creating a stunning, wide-eyed effect.

I appreciate that this mascara is also buildable. Whether I want a natural daytime look or a bold, dramatic evening look, I can achieve it with just a few coats. The formula is lightweight, so my lashes stay lifted without feeling heavy or weighed down. Plus, it doesn't flake or crumble, maintaining its integrity throughout wear.

The deep black color adds an extra touch of glamour to
reviews.zh:
我對呢支睫毛液超級興奮！佢完全改變咗我嘅睫毛，畀到我從來冇諗過嘅長度、豐盈同清晰度。配方唔單止持久，仲抗暈染，全日都保持住完美狀態。

呢支睫毛液與眾不同之處係佢創新嘅刷頭設計。刷毛間距剛剛好，確保每根睫毛都搽上啱啱份量嘅產品。棒身易於操控，可以精準上妝，唔會結塊或者一團糟。佢輕鬆提拉同分開每根睫毛，造出令人驚艷嘅大眼效果。

我亦都欣賞呢支睫毛液可以疊加。無論想自然嘅日妝定大膽嘅晚妝，搽多幾層就做到。質地輕身，睫毛保持提升而唔會覺得重或者下垂。而且佢唔會甩碎或者掉落，成日都保持完好。

深邃嘅黑色增添多一份魅力

reviews.text:
I'm extremely impressed with this mascara. I always curl my lashes, but many other mascaras that I've tried from brand names like Dior, Lancome, Benefit, among others, but they have always had bad fallout under my eyes & weighed down my lashes -- never holding a curl. Not only has this mascara held the curl throughout my work day in the sun, but there is absolutely NO FALL OUT which is my favorite. I also fell asleep last night with this mascara on & it still held the curl of my eyelashes this morning.
Tip: apply it slowly. I've noticed it does clump a bit if you apply it quickly, but when you apply it slowly, you get a beautiful effect.

TLDR: Maintains curled lashes, long-lasting, no fall out under the eyes, and removes easily with oil based cleanser. In the images provided, I only put one thin layer on my lashes.
reviews.zh:
我對呢支睫毛液印象深刻。我一向都會夾睫毛，但試過好多其他品牌嘅睫毛液，好似 Dior、Lancome、Benefit 等等，佢哋一直都會喺眼下面甩碎同埋扯低我嘅睫毛——從來都 hold 唔到捲度。呢支睫毛液唔單止喺我喺太陽底下返工全日都保持住捲度，而且完全冇甩碎——呢點係我最鍾意嘅。尋晚我仲瞓著咗覺，睫毛都冇卸，今朝起身捲度仲喺度。
提示：慢慢搽。我留意到如果搽得快會有少少結塊，但慢慢搽就會有好靚嘅效果。

簡單講：保持捲曲睫毛、持久、眼下面冇甩碎、用油性卸妝產品好容易卸。喺提供嘅圖片入面，我只係搽咗薄薄一層。

reviews.text:
Nope. This is NOT it. I was UNABLE to remove this mascara with the following: 1. Water, 2. Micellar Water, 3. Cleansing Oil, and 4. Cleansing Balm.

BEAUTIFUL hold, finish, and long lasting; however, after 45mins of trying to remove, it is too much for me. This will have all day hold, will not flake, and an amazing brush applicator allowing me to get right up to my lash line.

I do LOVE the CLIO Kill Lash Superproof Mascara (red tube) which is easily removed with water. Epic fail on my side for trying something different!
reviews.zh:
唔得。呢支完全唔啱。我用以下方法都卸唔到：1. 清水、2. 卸妝水、3. 卸妝油、4. 卸妝膏。

保持度、妝效同持久度都好靚；但試咗 45 分鐘都卸唔到我真係頂唔順。佢真係可以 hold 全日、唔會甩碎、支刷超好可以畫到睫毛根部。

我其實好鍾意 CLIO Kill Lash Superproof 睫毛液（紅色支），用清水就可以輕鬆卸走。貪新鮮試新嘢係我嘅大失敗！

reviews.text:
I purchased the mascara in #03 Sleek Volume. The mascara keeps the curl all day and lengthens and volumizes but still gets pretty flaky. When I apply the first coat of mascara, it already doesn't apply that smoothly as there will be some chunks attaching to my lashes. I think the formula is good but the applicator is just ok. It definitely takes some effort to remove. I use the Heimish All-Clean Cleansing Balm by melting some on my finger tips and using those fingers to really work in the oils on my lashes. If I take my time to lightly rub the lashes and let the oil soak then it removes without any harsh rubbing or cotton pads/q-tips. 

Follow me on IG: throughcoloredglasses for more honest reviews and tutorials.
reviews.zh:
我買咗 #03 Sleek Volume 嘅睫毛液。佢可以 hold 捲度全日，亦增長同增量，但仲係會幾甩碎。搽第一層嘅時候已經唔係好順，因為會有啲碎黐住睫毛。我覺得質地好，但刷頭一般。卸妝明顯要花功夫。我用 Heimish All-Clean 卸妝膏，喺指尖搓溶，再用手指將油分按摩入睫毛。如果慢慢輕揉，等油滲透，就唔使大力擦或者用化妝棉／棉花棒。

Follow me on IG: throughcoloredglasses 睇更多真實評價同教學。
